name: capstone-usls-platform
description: Graduate Student Lifecycle Monitoring and Analytics Platform — Flask JSON API + React (Vite + Tailwind) UI for the USLS Graduate School

scripts.setup: npm run install:python && npm run install:web && npm run build:web && npm run seed
scripts.install:python: python3 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
